info.title: Rin HTTP API
info.description: Authoritative preview wire contract for Rin Protocol v2. Bearer authentication is required only when the server is configured with a token; liveness and readiness probes are always unauthenticated.

bearerAuth.description: Used when the Rin server is configured with an authentication token.

SessionTransfer.description: A UTF-8 NDJSON stream ordered as manifest, one or more events, then complete. Content-Encoding other than identity is rejected.

Ready.description: The Store is readable and configured worker managers are running.

Metrics.description: Dependency-free Prometheus text exposition without player-content labels.

SessionStats.description: Bounded Session lifecycle and managed storage statistics.

SessionTransfer.description: A bounded-frame UTF-8 NDJSON stream. Only a final complete frame denotes success; an error frame denotes failure after response streaming began.

HostSchemaRef.description: Exact Host-owned schema identity. Rin preserves this reference but does not resolve it or treat its digest as proof that data was validated.

HostValidatedPayload.description: Assertion by the authenticated Host that data was validated against the exact referenced schema before Observe. Rin validates only the bounded strict-JSON envelope.
